Identify:
In the identification phase, we
evaluate significant issues in our
operating environment that may
impact our ability to create value and
deliver our strategy. These issues
could be financial, operational,
reputational, environmental,
social, strategic, or legislative.
Our evaluation considers three key
aspects:
1) How these issues affect the
accessibility, availability, and
affordability of our capitals.
2) Legitimate stakeholder feedback
3) Recent events as well as potential
issues that could have a short,
medium, or long-term impact on
our Group.
Prioritise:
Using the outcomes of this
assessment, we prioritize matters
that are most important to our
ability to generate sustained value
over time while considering key
risks and opportunities.
